goal: Prepare a public-safe verification summary for the supervisor-requested publication of the inactive Action Fusion prototype.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Only the inactive core, tests and focused documentation are publication inputs; no live activation or new comparison gate is claimed.
Focused synthetic coverage and the full repository gate pass without weakening capsules or policy controls.
The publication summary contains no private handoff contents, personal checkout paths, credentials, traces or local approvals; earlier local-only receipts remain local.

outcome.summary: The inactive prototype is verified for source publication. Native dispatcher binding, durable evidence integration and any measured efficiency gain remain unqualified. This is not a deployment or promotion receipt.

what_worked: Sixty-two synthetic prototype tests pass; the full suite reports one thousand two hundred sixty-seven passing tests and seven skips.
Final source review found no remaining issues within the inactive prototype scope.

evidence.summary: Documents the injected ports, bounded private outputs, cooperative deadline and absent native deployment guarantees.
Synthetic tests cover input bounds, sequencing, partial failures, evidence, cancellation and context forwarding.
Typecheck, build, full tests, capsules and offline guardrail and benchmark gates passed.

uncertainty.statement: Synthetic injected ports do not demonstrate native policy re-entrancy, process isolation, durable journal integration or model-round savings.
uncertainty.resolution: Retain the proposed contract's separate native qualification, opportunity screening and exact approval gates.

notes: The supervisor requested source publication, not activation or acceptance of an efficiency claim.
